title: C23: daily shorts from RSI lower highs and Bollinger-mid rejections

what.name: A: divergence
what.value_plain: bearish RSI divergence at a high, swings 3-40 days apart (repo rule)
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: A_major
what.value_plain: 5/5-day close pivots within 60 days, close >= 98% of the prior high, RSI >= 3 lower
what.label: OURS

what.name: B: mid rejection
what.value_plain: high reaches the BB mid, close below it, mid lower than 5 days ago; filters RSI < 60, lower band touched, RSI under its SMA
what.label: OURS

what.name: Exits
what.value_plain: 10-day and 20-day hold; band exit (lower band target, close above the signal high stop)
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 0.10% per round trip (Binance taker x2, backtest/fees.py); slippage and funding not modelled
what.label: SOURCED

how: daily_div_mid_reject.py, Binance spot daily 2017-08..2026-10; in-sample to 2022-12, out-of-sample from 2023-01.

verdict.label: NO: no variant beats simply being short every day in both periods.

why: Daily samples are small (13-54 per period): only a ~5% per trade edge could be seen.
Mid rejection beat the base by 3.3% in-sample but only 0.1% out-of-sample.
His 2026 examples did work (10-20 +3.4% in 5 days), which is why it looks tradable on the chart.
